Proposition
[Large distance spheres] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0501, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0502, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0503 ↗ lem:chow-iii-i37-angle-decay ↗ lem:chow-iii-i40-lipschitz-complete 1. appi:1.41\group Distance spheres

For all sufficiently large $s$, $S(p,s)$ is a Lipschitz hypersurface, its intrinsic length space is complete, and the number of its components equals the number of topological ends of $\M $.
